children: PTC Therapeutics completed acquisition of ST-920 and expects to finish a rolling BLA submission for accelerated FDA approval in Q4 2026.
Completed acquisition of ST-920, a BLA-stage one-time AAV gene therapy for Fabry disease from Sangamo.
Rolling BLA submission to FDA for accelerated approval is expected to be completed in Q4 2026.
BLA is supported by Phase 1/2 STAAR data showing meaningful renal benefit and favorable safety/tolerability over 52 weeks.
Company plans to pursue regulatory approval for ST-920 outside the United States as well.
